# basic-auth-prose: the word `basic` or `authorization` followed by lowercase words joined by
# slashes, as release notes, feature tables and code comments name an area of work. each value is
# twenty bytes or more and clears the 3.0 entropy gate of `http-basic-auth`. on a path without the
# documentation bonus, the rule's `base64_credential` check rejects values with a bad base64
# length, an ascii control byte or no colon. encoding and username content are not inferred.
# known gap: some slash prose, including lowercase, passes these byte checks. the generated
# `capitalised_and_mixed_prose_have_a_bounded_residual_on_every_library_surface` test bounds it.
The parser keeps Basic comments/highlighting stable across reloads.
- Basic structure/navigation for every supported grammar
| Basic completion/signatures | done |
Covers basic formatting/diagnostics for every grammar.
## Basic queries/injections/locals
authorization providers/middleware are registered at startup
basic   operators/precedence follow the reference manual
